name: Mephibosheth
title: Recipient of David's Grace
summary: Mephibosheth was the son of Jonathan and grandson of Saul. He became lame in both feet when his nurse dropped him while fleeing after Saul's death. David sought him out to show kindness for Jonathan's sake, restored Saul's land to him, and allowed him to eat at the king's table.

keyEvents.title: The Tragedy of Childhood
keyEvents.description: When news came of the deaths of Saul and Jonathan, the nurse fled with the five-year-old Mephibosheth but dropped him, leaving him lame.

keyEvents.title: David Seeks Out Saul's House
keyEvents.description: David asked if anyone remained from Saul's house to whom he could show kindness for Jonathan's sake.

keyEvents.title: Mephibosheth Found
keyEvents.description: The servant Ziba reported that Jonathan's son was living in Lo-debar. David brought him to Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: David's Kindness
keyEvents.description: David gave Mephibosheth all of Saul's land and let him eat at the king's table as one of the king's sons.

keyEvents.title: David's Loyalty
keyEvents.description: During Absalom's rebellion, Mephibosheth remained in Jerusalem and waited for David's return.
